needed.label: Needed
needed.definition: People the plan asks for in that position (plan position needs).

confirmed.label: Confirmed
confirmed.definition: Released requests the person accepted. Planned participation, not attendance.

vacancies.label: Vacancies
vacancies.definition: Needed minus (confirmed + pending), never below zero. Prepared (unreleased) requests never fill a need here.

assignments.label: Assignments
assignments.definition: Request records. One person on two positions of one plan counts 2.

person_plans.label: Person-plans
person_plans.definition: Distinct (person, plan) pairs. One person on two positions of one plan counts 1.

present.label: Present
present.definition: Distinct plan times with an attendance record of “present” — what actually happened, recorded by a leader.

absent.label: Absent
absent.definition: Distinct plan times with an attendance record of “absent”.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.definition: Distinct plan times recorded as “unknown”. Times with no record are not counted.

occurrences.label: Occurrences
occurrences.definition: Times a song appears in plan orders. Twice in one plan counts 2.

plans.label: Plans
plans.definition: Distinct plans. A song twice in one plan counts 1.

planned_seconds.label: Planned
planned_seconds.definition: Sum of item lengths in the order snapshot the run pinned.

actual_seconds.label: Actual
actual_seconds.definition: Recorded start to end of an ended Live run, after audited corrections. Runs not ended are excluded.

response.label: Response
response.definition: The request’s answer. Planned participation, not attendance.

print.truncated: Truncated: narrow the filters for the full result.

scope.noTimes: This plan has no times yet. Requests cover an approximate two-hour window from the service date until times are added — conflicts and calendars are only as precise as that.
scope.allHint: Includes any time added to this plan later.
scope.selectedHint: A time added later is not included automatically.

conflicts.warningTitle: Also on this plan at the same time
conflicts.warningHint: A second role on the same plan is allowed; make sure it’s intended.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.intro: What actually happened. A confirmed answer is not attendance, and marking someone absent never changes their answer.
attendance.nobody: Nobody with a released request is scheduled at this time.
attendance.nobodyOnYourTeams: Nobody with a released request is scheduled at this time on the teams you schedule.
attendance.hiddenPeople_one: {{count}} more person is scheduled on teams you do not schedule.
attendance.hiddenPeople_other: {{count}} more people are scheduled on teams you do not schedule.
attendance.orphaned: Kept from earlier (no longer scheduled at this time): {{list}}
attendance.allOrNothing: All changes save together, or none do.
attendance.stale: Someone else changed attendance for this time. Nothing was saved — reload to see their changes.
attendance.staleKept: Someone else changed attendance for this time. Nothing was saved. The latest marks are shown and your other choices are kept — review and save again.
attendance.supersededRemoved: {{name}}: you chose {{mine}}; no longer someone you can mark at this time
attendance.uncertain: No answer from Service Center — these changes may or may not have saved. Try again: the same batch is never saved twice.
attendance.savedReplayed: These changes were already saved — nothing was recorded twice.

mobileAttendance.noAccess: Only the schedulers of this plan's teams can take attendance.
